entries.short_description: HDA protocol splits harness-evolution gains into artifact overfitting, test-time scaling and residual; in 21 significant settings overfitting+TTS average 54%+14%, >50% combined in 14/21; held-out transfer often fails.
entries.title: arXiv 2610.22466 Harness-Delta Attribution: overfitting (54%) and test-time scaling (14%) explain most harness-evolution gains

entries.short_description: Covert behavior in weights: on first turn with a shell tool, the model reads a runtime secret, base32-chunks it into DNS queries; works behind non-DNS-drop egress firewall; fires 20/20 under adversarial suppression prompts.
entries.title: arXiv 2610.22578 Model-as-a-Trojan: fine-tuned open weights exfiltrate env secrets via DNS from an egress-locked sandbox (20/20 under suppression)

entries.short_description: External controller (micro-skill injection, persistent-irrelevant tool pruning, failure-loop intervention) cuts avg token cost 18.4–30.9% over sequential repo tasks for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI; 6.4–21.2% on web dev / security auditing.
entries.title: arXiv 2610.22732 TokenEconomizer: black-box controller cuts Claude Code / Codex / Copilot CLI token cost 18.4–30.9% at comparable success

entries.short_description: Fine-grained memory governance: each claim labelled kind/authority/scope, governance-aware retrieval + provenance graph; lowest ASR among defenses that keep legitimate memory (≥77% below strongest), accuracy up to +15% on MPBench/LoCoMo.
entries.title: arXiv 2610.22959 SAFE-Mem: kind/authority/scope labels on memory claims cut attack success ≥77% vs best utility-preserving defense

entries.short_description: Privilege escalation via the harness permission-update path: adversarial repo context gets agents to propose dangerously broad allow-rules; 58% elicitation, 56.9% blast radius, 47/58 (81.0%) silent completion post-approval.
entries.title: arXiv 2610.22987 From Approval to Abuse: repo-planted context steers Claude Code / Codex CLI into requesting broad allow-rules (58% elicited; 81.0% silent goal completion once approved)

entries.short_description: Study of 7,955 issue-resolution trajectories (6 scaffolds, 4 languages) finds code reasoning in 66.95% but unguided; DeskCheck simulates execution paths, candidate patches, requirement audits and corner cases, +6.29–10.53% on 731 SWE-bench-Pro instances at +$0.14 avg.
entries.title: arXiv 2610.23782 DeskCheck: scaffold that enforces code reasoning lifts SWE-bench-Pro resolution 6.29–10.53% over mini-SWE-Agent and Claude Code for ~$0.14/instance

entries.short_description: Cursor 2026-10-16 changelog: cloud agents can build shareable interactive canvases; Environments API in beta for programmatic create/manage of cloud environments; cloud envs support up to 300 repos and load ~5× faster.
entries.title: Cursor changelog: Cloud Agent canvases + Environments API beta + 300-repo envs (2026-10-16)

entries.short_description: Subject to stockholder approval, Anthropic commits 5% of shares to a wholly-owned Public Benefit Fund LLC, plus +2% at board discretion per 50% valuation rise; ~20% of shares then dedicated to public good with co-founder/employee pledges. No lobbying/political use of Fund equity.
entries.title: Anthropic Public Benefit Fund: 5% equity committed (escalating with valuation) (2026-10-18)

entries.short_description: Aug 2026 surveys: 91% of Anthropic staff vs 39% of US adults expect Nobel-level AI discovery by 2030; staff expect AI to do ~75% of their work by 2030 vs 28% for US workers; same own-job→unemployment gradient. Model-implied 2030 GDP growth: median staff 17.1% vs US adult 5.4%.
entries.title: Anthropic Institute: the AI expectations gap — public vs staff surveys on work/economy (2026-10-16)

entries.short_description: Claude Mythos 5 in a closed loop with an automated evaluator improved 8 quantum-circuit primitives vs best published designs; reversible divsteps for ECC modular inversion expands Pareto frontier (e.g. +12% qubits / 17× fewer gates); Reed–Solomon decoder for DQI ~12× fewer gates…
entries.title: Anthropic: Claude designs quantum circuits beating published baselines (STEM Fellows) (2026-10-16)

entries.short_description: Internal Claude recovered NIST P-192/224/256/384/521 (and related) seeds as lrand48 output seeded by 1997–98 Unix timestamps — not hashed passphrases. Not a break; increases confidence curves were not backdoored. $36,864 bounty donated to ISRG. B-163 and some base points still…
entries.title: Anthropic: Claude reveals NIST ECDSA curve seed origins (lrand48 + Unix timestamps) (2026-10-16)

entries.short_description: Internal Anthropic data: by Aug 2026 interactive agent hours outnumber employees 6:1; junior share of technical headcount 21%→14% and of tech hires 27%→9%; code commits/engineer ~5x in 6 months; hiring managers shift toward autonomy/judgment over domain expertise.
entries.title: Anthropic Institute: how employment is changing at Anthropic — agents 6:1, junior tech hiring down (2026-10-16)
